entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Planeswalker of Dominaria with Ley Druid and Elder Druid powers who defeated Ravidel and later joined the New Coalition.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Jared's father who sacrificed his wife to Ravidel.

entities.name: Gwendolyn Carthalion
entities.description: Jared's mother, sacrificed.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker who deceived Adam and was Jared's enemy.

entities.name: Ezer
entities.description: Spellsquire of Adam who raised Jared.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Ally who saved Jared and was killed.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Planeswalker who taught Jared and fell in love with him.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: Ally killed at the Dueling Chasm.

entities.name: Caliphear the Nightmare
entities.description: Ally in the battle.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: Jared's maternal grandfather.

entities.name: Ulf
entities.description: Student Jared defended.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Presence Jared wishes to free Corondor from.

entities.name: New Coalition
entities.description: Alliance against the second Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Foecleaver
entities.description: Jared's sword.

entities.name: Black Lotus
entities.description: Artifact Jared stole and used to summon a Shivan Dragon.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact destroyed with the long-daggers.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War started by the Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Dominaria

events.summary: Adam sacrifices his wife to Ravidel, refuses to sacrifice Jared and battles Ravidel; Jared is hit by a syphon soul and changed.
events.quote: Jared was hit by a syphon soul in this battle

events.summary: Jared grows up a beggar in Arathoxia raised by Ezer.
events.quote: brought up by his father's spellsquire Ezer

events.summary: Ravidel conquers Arathoxia; Jared steals the Lotus, leads refugees against Ravidel at Castle Melmereth and summons a Shivan Dragon.
events.quote: Ravidel tracked Jared down and conquered Arathoxia

events.summary: Kristina takes Jared in, teaches him all mana, and they fall in love.
Jared learns Ravidel is alive; Liana dies; Ravidel activates the Mox Beacon starting the Planeswalker War.
events.quote: activated the Mox Beacon that would start the Planeswalker War

events.summary: Jared battles Ravidel at the Dueling Chasm, ascends as a planeswalker and saves Kristina, though Altair dies.
events.quote: Jared ascended and became a planeswalker

events.summary: Jared likely loses his immortality in the Great Mending.
events.quote: losing his immortality and godlike powers

events.summary: Jared joins the New Coalition and defends Ulf at the Tolarian Academy of Lat-Nam.
events.quote: defending the student Ulf against the sleeper agents

relations.quote: Jared battled Ravidel at the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
who began to teach him to use all aspects of mana
joining with the New Coalition to protect his homeland
